editorial.blurb: An all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ gem where you grill premium meats and seafood tableside at an unbeatable price point, creating a fun, interactive feast with friends and family.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or make a reservation for groups of 5+; order from the tablet to maximize your 90-120 minute window, and request a table near the front to avoid the smokiest areas in the back.
